title_en: Notice Regarding Market Purchase of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
Yoshicon announced market purchases of treasury stock through August 2026 and provided an update on its authorized buyback program. During August 2026, the company purchased 10,400 shares for ¥22.44 million via market transactions including ToSTNeT-3 transactions on the Tokyo Stock Exchange.

Cumulatively since the program commenced on May 1, 2026, Yoshicon has acquired 134,500 shares for ¥293.04 million. This represents progress toward the board-authorized limit of 200,000 shares (2.9% of issued shares excluding treasury stock) for up to ¥500 million. The acquisition period extends through March 31, 2027. No specific rationale for the buyback program was disclosed in this announcement.
